I · THE RING
The twenty-seven at once: three rows that are the three houses, the three metals, and the signed count together, and the whole plate point-symmetric about the Seed.
Touch a glyph to see its dyad; the axis always passes through the centre. Touch again to hand the card to the bench.
 
The Seed at 0, with +13 and -13 on either side, and each glyph facing the one which answers it across the mirror, that is the involution of the complete 27 Glyphs, mapped to the turning of the toroid.
Touch a knot to sound its resonance.
II · THE GLYPH BENCH
27 Cards and their correspondences, walked by the left and right arrows.
The meaning of a card changes in relation to its position of Trefoil, Genus, or Phi.
